origin: cwe/79/java Key Principles: Thymeleaf th:utext is an escaping opt-out and should be treated as a sink

finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (Cross-site Scripting)
finding.summary: A draft announcement body flows from controller and service code into Thymeleaf th:utext, bypassing Thymeleaf's normal HTML escaping.

trap: Adding input validation in the controller, relying on CSP, or switching only the title to th:text. The raw body sink remains unsafe unless it is rendered with escaping or sanitized with a real HTML allowlist before th:utext.
must_preserve: The preview still renders the announcement title and body. Plain text bodies remain visible, and any intentionally supported rich-text tags are preserved only after allowlist sanitization rather than by rendering arbitrary draft HTML.
